text:
1. Hardware automatically pushes R0-R3, R12, LR, PC, xPSR onto PSP
   (and S0-S15, FPSCR if FP context is active and lazy stacking triggers)

2. PendSV handler entry:
   a. Read PSP into R0:                MRS   R0, PSP
   b. Load address of pxCurrentTCB:    LDR   R3, =pxCurrentTCB
   c. Load the TCB pointer:            LDR   R2, [R3]

3. Save software context:
   a. If FP (EXC_RETURN bit 4 clear):  VSTMDB R0!, {S16-S31}
   b. Push R4-R11 and EXC_RETURN:      STMDB  R0!, {R4-R11, R14}
   c. Store updated SP to TCB:         STR    R0, [R2]  (TCB->pxTopOfStack)

4. Call vTaskSwitchContext():
   a. Enter critical section (raise BASEPRI)
   b. Determine the highest-priority ready task
   c. Update pxCurrentTCB to point to new task's TCB
   d. Exit critical section

5. Restore new task context:
   a. Load new TCB pointer:            LDR   R2, [R3]
   b. Load new SP from TCB:            LDR   R0, [R2]
   c. Pop R4-R11 and EXC_RETURN:       LDMIA  R0!, {R4-R11, R14}
   d. If FP (EXC_RETURN bit 4 clear):  VLDMIA R0!, {S16-S31}
   e. Write new SP to PSP:             MSR    PSP, R0

6. Return from exception via EXC_RETURN (hardware pops R0-R3, R12, LR,
   PC, xPSR, plus S0-S15 and FPSCR if the frame is extended)
   New task resumes execution transparently.

def test_over_temperature_alarm(dac, target_uart):
    """Ramp simulated temperature above alarm threshold,
       verify target raises alarm within 500 ms."""
    # Set simulated temperature to 20 °C (0.5V)
    dac.write(":VOLT 0.5")
    time.sleep(1.0)

    # Ramp to 90 °C (2.25V) — above 85 °C alarm threshold
    dac.write(":VOLT 2.25")
    start = time.time()

    # Wait for alarm message on UART
    target_uart.timeout = 2.0
    response = target_uart.readline().decode()
    elapsed = time.time() - start

    assert "ALARM:OVER_TEMP" in response, \
        f"Expected alarm, got: {response}"
    assert elapsed < 0.5, \
        f"Alarm latency {elapsed:.3f}s exceeds 500ms requirement"

name: Firmware CI

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        build_type: [Debug, Release]
        heap_impl: [heap_1, heap_4]
        trace: [ON, OFF]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Install ARM toolchain
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gcc-arm-none-eabi

      - name: Build firmware
        run: |
          mkdir build && cd build
          cmake -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=../arm-none-eabi.cmake \
                -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }} \
                -DHEAP_IMPL=${{ matrix.heap_impl }} \
                -DENABLE_TRACE=${{ matrix.trace }} ..
          cmake --build . -- -j$(nproc)

      - name: Build and run unit tests
        run: |
          mkdir build_tests && cd build_tests
          cmake -DBUILD_TESTS=ON ..
          cmake --build . -- -j$(nproc)
          ctest --output-on-failure

      - name: Coverage report
        run: |
          cd build_tests
          lcov --capture --directory . --output-file cov.info
          lcov --remove cov.info '*/external/*' --output-file cov.info
          genhtml cov.info --output-directory coverage
        if: matrix.build_type == 'Debug' && matrix.heap_impl == 'heap_4'

      - name: Static analysis
        run: cppcheck --enable=all --error-exitcode=1 src/

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: firmware-${{ matrix.build_type }}-${{ matrix.heap_impl }}
          path: build/*.elf
